attempts.actual_result: Live Chrome and native Brave checks passed: sandbox creation, three chips/TTL/note, bot bids, human $120 acceptance, active-room return link, readable 360px header/chips/controls/history with no horizontal overflow, and actual hidden-tab pause/resume.
attempts.note: Brave sandbox held at five bids while hidden; after foregrounding it resumed to seven, then accepted the human bid. With the tab hidden, the native DOM inspector showed the exact background-paused paragraph. Controlled Chrome kept reporting visible, so it was not used as pause evidence. Chrome console clear; Brave favicon.ico 404 recorded as a non-M4 asset limitation. Viewport, DevTools dock and own tabs restored/closed; own server stopped. Screenshot: qa/evidence/M4-mobile.jpg.
